title: Informal workers in Senegal, Mali and Burkina Faso have been hit harder by COVID-19
summary: A survey of 900 people in Senegal, Mali and Burkina Faso in spring 2020 found that informal workers were more likely to lose their jobs, see their earnings fall and struggle to meet basic needs. The authors set out what this means for social protection and support for small businesses.
keyPoints: Informal workers were more likely to lose their jobs and earnings.
The pattern held in high-risk sectors too.
Informal workers were more likely to struggle to meet basic needs.
